fields.title-post: How can you free up time for your catering teams?
fields.rt-blog-html:
In foodservice, every minute counts. Optimizing time management is therefore a real challenge, not only to guarantee customer satisfaction, but also to improve your establishment's profitability. In this article, you'll discover how to free up time for your foodservice teams, by improving organization and processes, investing in employee well-being and choosing the right technological tools.

‍

Understanding the challenges of time management in the foodservice industry

In the foodservice sector, staff face a number of constraints that make time management particularly challenging. Schedules are often irregular, with intense service peaks when pressure is at its height. Unforeseen events, such as stock shortages or last-minute orders, are frequent and require constant responsiveness. These daily challenges lead to a considerable workload, in a context where employees struggle to free up their time. 

Moreover, the lack of qualified personnel, a recurring problem in the sector, exacerbates these constraints. Employees often find themselves managing several tasks at once, which can lead to delays and errors. This situation not only disrupts the smooth running of the establishment, but also impacts the quality of the work delivered and, consequently, customer satisfaction.

These constraints have a direct impact on team productivity. When employees are overloaded, the likelihood of errors increases, which can lead to delays in service and a loss of time spent resolving these problems. Service quality declines, and this often translates into lower customer satisfaction. Ultimately, the repercussions are felt in terms of guest loyalty and profitability profitability.

A stressful work environment affects employee morale. Chronic stress can lead to burnout, demotivation and high turnover. This instability within teams undermines cohesion and makes effective time management even more difficult, creating a vicious circle from which it is difficult to escape.

👉 To find out more : How can you improve guest satisfaction in foodservice?

‍

Optimize organization and processes to save time

Automate repetitive tasks and improve schedule management 

Automating repetitive tasks is one of the most effective ways of freeing up your catering teams' time. Tasks such as stock management, order taking or order preparation can be automated using specialized software and mobile applications. For example, online ordering platforms enable customers to place their orders in advance, reducing waiting time and minimizing input errors.

Automated inventory management systems also offer considerable advantages. They monitor stock levels in real time and automatically trigger replenishments when necessary, thus avoiding product shortages. This automation enables teams to concentrate on more complex, higher value-added tasks, while improving overall plant efficiency.

Efficient scheduling is essential for optimizing the use of time in foodservice operations. By using schedule management tools, it is possible to anticipate staffing requirements in line with forecasts, adjust schedules fairly and ensure a better distribution of tasks. This helps to limit periods of understaffing or overstaffing, improving service flow and reducing downtime.

Reduce friction points to accelerate service

Friction points, such as long waiting times at the checkout or when taking an order, can greatly affect the customer experience. By investing in solutions such as those offered by Innovorder, these delays can be reduced thanks to fast, automated payment systems. Tray scanning with AI eliminates queues, cutting checkout times by a factor of 3.

The fluidity of service is extremely important in the foodservice sector, with high occupancy rates between 12.15 and 12.45 p.m., which is why we opted for IA Scan. Céline Le Gall, Regional Manager, Api Restauration

By reducing these friction points, you improve customer satisfaction, so that they really enjoy their lunch break. You also free up staff time to concentrate on other critical tasks, such as greeting guests or managing orders in the kitchen.

👉 To find out more: How can you use artificial intelligence in your restaurant? 

‍

Maximize employee well-being and training to free up time

Invest in training and task delegation

Investing in a training program focused on service efficiency is an excellent way to improve time management in foodservice. Proper training will enable employees to master the tools and techniques they need to perform their tasks more quickly and accurately. And don't overlook the importance of delegating tasks, so as to spread the workload evenly, and even out the overload of the most experienced employees.

Training teams in the use of technological tools, such as online booking platforms and ordering applications, will make them more autonomous and efficient, while reducing the risk of errors.

Leveraging employee well-being to boost productivity

Employee well-being is a powerful lever if you want to boost the productivity of your collective restaurant. A healthy, pleasant working environment reduces stress, boosts motivation and lowers turnover. Have you thought about offering them benefits such as flexible working hours, extra breaks, free meals and the opportunity to express themselves? This can go a long way towards improving the working atmosphere.

An employee who feels valued, respected and enjoys coming to work is more committed and, consequently, more efficient in his or her daily tasks. This translates into better service quality and increased customer satisfaction , boosting profitability.

👉 To find out more: How can you use artificial intelligence in your restaurant? 

‍

Choosing the right tools to support your teams

To choose the tools best suited to your establishment, it's essential to clearly identify your needs. For example, if you find that waiting times at the cash register are a recurring problem, investing in rapid payment systems or self-checkouts could be a solution. Similarly, if managing schedules is a challenge, human resources management software could simplify the task.

Online booking platforms and ordering applications are also invaluable tools, enabling customers to plan their visits and place orders in advance, thus reducing pressure on staff during peak hours.

The adoption of intuitive solutions, such as those offered by Innovorder, is facilitated by their simplified interface, enabling rapid integration and easy learning for teams. Come and discuss this directly with our experts! 

For the tools chosen to be truly effective, they must be adopted and correctly used by the teams. This requires a gradual integration phase, accompanied by appropriate training and regular follow-up. Involving employees in the tool selection process can also facilitate adoption, by making them more receptive to change.

👉 To find out more: Which cashiering system for foodservice? 

To free up time for your catering teams, you need a global, coherent approach. This includes technological solutions, efficient organization and investment in employee well-being. These combined strategies will enable you to improve the performance and profitability of your establishment, while enhancing customer satisfaction and loyalty.
